name: Come back soon, Oddie
source:
Afterlife consists in a great field of yellow flowers, green mountains and a beautiful purple sky adorned with millions of stars. All these sights, however, don't impress Paulo, a deceased knight that wanders eternity.

He waits for the death of his best friend, Oddie, so they can pass through a magic door and reincarnate together. But while he waits, he starts to wonder if his comrade will remember him after living a full life...
